appDescription: Voice-first public toilet detours: compare available time-to-toilet estimates, find another public toilet when closed, and resume the original destination.

function.name: PITSTOP_FIND_RESTROOM
function.description: For urgent requests such as 급똥 or 화장실 안내해줘, find an unrestricted public toilet and request navigation to verified parking. Remember the original destination first.

alternative.description: Mark the current stop unavailable and find another public toilet (same behavior as PITSTOP_NEXT_RESTROOM).

function.name: PITSTOP_NEXT_RESTROOM
function.description: When the user says 여기 닫혔어, 이용할 수 없어, or 다른 곳으로 안내해줘, exclude the current stop for this session and request another public toilet from the current vehicle location.

function.name: PITSTOP_RESUME_DESTINATION
function.description: When the user says 원래 목적지로 가자 or 기존 목적지 안내 이어줘, request a new route to the destination remembered before the public toilet detour. Report when no original destination was available.
